title: 角色扮演AI聊天机器人：以幽默方式反思AI的局限
summary: 本文介绍了一个名为“Your AI Slop Bores Me”的创意项目，该项目通过角色扮演AI聊天机器人的方式，让用户以幽默和讽刺的视角体验AI的交互过程。项目界面简洁，包含两个标签页：一个用于输入用户请求（模拟人类用户），另一个用于提交AI式回答（模拟AI回复）。其核心设计在于，交互双方实际上都是人类，但通过模仿AI的生成风格和常见缺陷（如重复、空洞、缺乏深度），引发对当前AI技术局限性的反思。文章强调，这种“角色扮演”不仅是一种娱乐形式，更是一种批判性工具，帮助公众理解AI生成内容的机械性和局限性，同时提醒人们警惕对AI的过度依赖。该项目在社交媒体上引发热议，成为探讨AI伦理和用户体验的趣味案例。
summary_en: This article introduces a creative project called 'Your AI Slop Bores Me', which allows users to roleplay as an AI chatbot in a humorous and satirical way. The interface features two tabs: one for entering user requests (simulating a human user) and another for submitting AI-style answers (simulating an AI response). The key design is that both sides are actually humans, but by mimicking AI's generation style and common flaws (such as repetition, emptiness, and lack of depth), it prompts reflection on the limitations of current AI technology. The article emphasizes that this roleplay is not just entertainment but also a critical tool to help the public understand the mechanical nature and limitations of AI-generated content, while reminding people to be wary of over-reliance on AI. The project has sparked discussions on social media, becoming a fun case for exploring AI ethics and user experience.
